traces.name: progress backed by a read grows the limit
the limit grows by a fixed step up to the ceiling
a ceiling equal to the calls never grows
two proving ledgers with no read between them grow the limit once
each proving ledger with a read since the last growth grows the limit
each candidate closed with evidence grows the limit: one candidate
each candidate closed with evidence grows the limit: two candidates at once
each candidate closed with evidence grows the limit: a candidate with no closing
each candidate closed with evidence grows the limit: the model's own hypothesis
each candidate closed with evidence grows the limit: three candidates up to the ceiling
a ledger with no read at all earns nothing
the stage follows the ledger: no ledger
the stage follows the ledger: hypotheses with no evidence
the stage follows the ledger: one open with evidence
the stage follows the ledger: one ruled out and one open
the stage follows the ledger: all ruled out
the stage follows the ledger: supported and one still open
the stage follows the ledger: supported and none open
the stage follows the ledger: the budget is ending with no ledger
the stage follows the ledger: the budget is ending with hypotheses
the stage follows the ledger: one call before the ending
the stage line names the stage and the calls
a stage change is reported once
a conclude stage sends the save message at once and only once
